description: Pull transformer offline; SFRA + Doble PF; rewind or replace as needed

Major overhaul at 50000 ops or 7 yr
Vacuum dry; replace if PD persists
Replace damaged busbar/insulator; full NETA MTS test
Quarterly IR scan of all bolted joints
Use Doble TDR; measure open/close timing
Re-torque to design value;replace damaged hardware
Replace UPS DC-bus caps at 5-7 yr
Replace battery / starter / fuel system as needed
Replace head gasket;machine head if warped
Replace plug + busway section if damaged
